name: Crime and Punishment
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Crime and Punishment was written by Fyodor Dostoevsky, first published in 1866.
Raskolnikov, a poor student, murders a pawnbroker and is consumed by psychological torment -- a deep dive into guilt, justification, and conscience.
Discussion prompt: Guilt & Redemption is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
